def main():
    n = int(input())
    ones = [0] * 17
    for i in range(1, 17):
        ones[i] = 10 * ones[i - 1] + 1
    print(calculate(ones, n, 16))

def calculate(ones, n, idx):
    quotient = n // ones[idx]
    remainder = n % ones[idx]
    total = quotient * idx
    if remainder == 0:
        return total
    else:
        optionA = calculate(ones, remainder, idx - 1)
        optionB = idx + calculate(ones, ones[idx] - remainder, idx - 1)
        return total + min(optionA, optionB)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
